title.narrative: Open Data Platform for Monitoring Poverty Reduction Programs

description.narrative: The project aims to strengthen the capacity of the National Anti-Poverty Commission to monitor key poverty reduction programs as platform for constructive engagement between the government and civil society. The proposed project would contribute to the achievement of the overall CAS objective of promoting inclusive growth by improving monitoring of local poverty situation/plans and status of key poverty reduction programs as basis for stronger engagement between government and civil society. Specifically, the proposed operation is in line with the CAS strategic objective towards better public services (CAS strategic objective 3) and improved governance (CAS objective 5). The project will have 2 major components as follows: Component1: Designing and Installing the Open Data Platform: This will involve the development of a management information system that will capture the local poverty profile of the 609 priority areas covered by the Bottom-Up Budgeting (BUB) as well as basic information, profile, status and intended outputs/outcomes of the poverty reduction (PR) programs/projects that were approved under the BUB. Component 2: Establishing Community of Practice for Poverty Reduction Monitoring and Policy Dialogue: The establishment of the open-data PR monitoring system will be a process of strengthening a constructive engagement among the government agencies, basic sector councils (civil society), local government units and the NAPC Secretariat. To enhance the capacity of the government and citizens/civil society organizations for constructive engagement in joint monitoring of key poverty reduction programs as basis for policy dialogue.
